records.name: Dr. Akuta Jetzt
records.biography_en: Jetzt keeps the HyperNorm response desk moving with a clipboard held below an expression already halfway through the next question. A card allowing urgency to include uncertainty tightens her uneven teeth: a concern is either pressing or holding up the queue. Hunky & Dory request a clear assessment. She grips the board, trying to leave one small space in which the answer may still change.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Dringlichkeit ist festgestellt. Die Ungewissheit versucht noch, rechtzeitig vorzusprechen.

variant_notes.note_en: She can make room for an emergency more easily than for the uncertainty preceding it.

records.name: Sanitäter Gleichda
records.biography_en: Gleichda reaches the HyperNorm entrance with an orange case held firmly beneath his alarmed brave smile. A card allowing readiness to coexist with surprise lifts his inner brows: a situation is either manageable or not yet properly met. Men in Black request a dependable response. He checks the handle, grateful for one part of the arrival that fits securely in both hands.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Hilfe ist eingetroffen. Die Lage wurde gebeten, sich entsprechend einzurichten.

variant_notes.note_en: He has brought the equipment and is hoping the situation will agree to become manageable.

records.name: Dr. Atemruhe
records.biography_en: Atemruhe waits in the HyperNorm treatment corner with a blue bag cradled at his belly and a face determined not to join the general alarm. A card allowing calm to include vigilance deepens his crooked pout: an interruption is either controlled or unnecessarily dramatic. Hunky & Dory praise composure. He adjusts his grip, preserving a little quiet that has not yet become inattention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Ruhe ist vorhanden. Sie möchte nicht mit Abwesenheit verwechselt werden.

variant_notes.note_en: He would like the next interruption to announce itself at a considerate volume.

records.name: Dr. Schnittklar
records.biography_en: Schnittklar studies a folded stack of gauze in the HyperNorm work corner with a steel instrument held low beside it. A card allowing a careful result to remain provisional compresses his lip: an edge is either clear or awaiting attention. Men in Black request a definitive finish. He looks down again, unable to ignore the small distinction his certainty had hoped to spare him.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Genauigkeit ist erreicht. Ihre abschließende Bestätigung wurde erneut vertagt.

variant_notes.note_en: He expects precision to settle the matter and remains irritated when the matter requires another look.

records.name: Pflegerin Wachzeit
records.biography_en: Wachzeit keeps the HyperNorm observation corner under a gaze more patient than its owner feels. A card allowing care to include an unrecorded moment of rest softens her unequal eyes: a change is either accounted for or still asking for attention. Hunky & Dory praise her constancy. She holds the small apparatus steady, wishing dependable care could occasionally include the person doing it.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Aufmerksamkeit ist gesichert. Die Aufmerksame hat ihren Bedarf noch nicht angemeldet.

variant_notes.note_en: She notices the small change before the system has decided that it qualifies as an event.

records.name: Dr. Taktgefühl
records.biography_en: Taktgefühl holds a small monitor below his uneven worried eyes in the HyperNorm consultation area. A card allowing a useful signal to remain only part of the account catches his lower lip: a pattern is either reassuring or insufficiently explained. Men in Black request a definite reading. He studies the line again, hoping its neatness will leave enough room for what it cannot show.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Verlauf ist sichtbar. Seine Beruhigung wurde noch nicht an den Betrachter weitergegeben.

variant_notes.note_en: He trusts a clear trace until somebody asks whether the situation might be larger than the screen.
